description: This file defines a Swift class `RemotePortTunnel` responsible for creating and managing SSH-based port forwarding tunnels, particularly for remote mode operation. It includes methods for establishing the SSH tunnel, port management, and cleanup procedures. The class interacts heavily with system networking APIs and configurations.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A final class managing SSH port forwarding tunnels, including setup, cleanup, and port management functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of `RemotePortTunnel` by establishing an SSH tunnel with specified remote port and preferences. Handles port selection, SSH process configuration, and error handling.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH tunnel process and performs cleanup.
